material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: A breakaway gap down
material.text: On Oct 27 it gapped down out of a tight range on 4.4x volume and has held (−5.8% at the open).
material.learn: A gap out of a range on heavy volume that holds: the start of a move.

material.head: Weekly: a deep wave 2
material.text: Five clean waves up from Jun 13, 2022 to Oct 27, 2025 (+114%, wave 1). The pullback is under the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+17% to +1.6%), in three waves, with the Oct 30, 2023 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−18%); a close over the wave-1 high (+75%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: Falling swing highs and lows are the steps of a downtrend.

against.head: MACD just turned down
against.text: MACD crossed below its signal line on Oct 27, below zero: momentum renewing in the trend's direction.
against.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the Jul 8 low, the 61.8% retracement of the Jun 11–Aug 27 rise and the Apr 21 high, where 4 levels (2 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Pullback in an uptrend
material.text: Price has dipped below its 50-day average but holds above the rising 200-day, with the 50-day above the 200-day.
material.learn: A dip inside an uptrend; buyers often return at support.

material.head: Buyers stepping in earlier (weekly)
material.text: Weekly: a higher low in price (the week of Sep 28) against a lower low in momentum (5 of 7 gauges): hidden bullish divergence.
material.learn: Higher price lows while momentum sets lower lows: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.

material.head: In a 7-week base
material.text: It has moved sideways for 7 weeks in a range 16% deep after a +25% advance.
material.learn: A sideways range after a move, where the stock rests before its next leg.
